name: a fictitious regulated power supply
chain: The circuit is a fictitious regulated power supply: the mains enters through bridge rectifier D1, passes through filter capacitor C1 then regulator U1, and exits through output capacitor C2 to the load.

components.name: Bridge rectifier
components.visual_notes: Molded bridge rectifier, legible reference marking.

components.name: Filter capacitor
components.visual_notes: Through-hole cylindrical capacitor, legible reference marking.

components.name: Regulator
components.role: Provides a stable 5 V output voltage
components.visual_notes: Regulator in standard package, legible reference marking.

components.name: Output capacitor
components.visual_notes: Through-hole cylindrical capacitor, legible reference marking.

nominal: Manufacturer datasheet, normal operation: TP1: 11.5 V DC, 2.00 Vpp, clean; TP2: 12.0 V DC, 0.20 Vpp, clean; TP3: 12.0 V DC, 0.20 Vpp, clean; TP4: 5.00 V DC, 0.02 Vpp, clean; TP5: 5.00 V DC, 0.01 Vpp, clean; TP6: 5.00 V DC, 0.01 Vpp, clean. TP1 carries a high ripple in normal operation, since it is the raw output of the bridge rectifier.
symptom: The output voltage is not stable.
